title: Social Media Specialist
excerpt: Requisition ID 2026-4382 Job Summary Artemis is seeking a Social Media Specialist with demonstrated experience supporting media monitoring, multimedia, and strategic communications contracts within the federal sector. The Social Media Specialist will be responsible for drafting social media and multimedia content, supporting media monitoring reporting quality assurance, and helping translate disaster assistance, preparedness, mitigation, recovery, and…

reasons.label: Customer-facing email, web and campaign content
Checking content against a source of truth
Concise defect feedback to designers and developers

whyMatched: The title is not one you would have searched for, but the responsibilities are: this posting is about reviewing and checking content somebody else produced, which is the work you have done for ten years. What it asks for: proofreading and copy editing, review and sign-off before publication and accuracy, verification and discrepancy detection — the responsibilities you have held for ten years. 2 of the board's co-occurrence rules fired, which is stronger evidence than any single phrase. Primarily CREATING: the title says “social media specialist”, so the job is producing content, not checking it.

evidence.label: Professional proofreading and copy editing
evidence.evidence: Proofread customer-facing copy daily for ten years — spelling, grammar, punctuation, capitalization, hyphenation, trademarks and product terminology — as the last review before publication.

evidence.label: Checking content against a source of truth
evidence.evidence: Investigated inconsistencies by comparing campaign assets against the live site, previous campaigns and product data — determining the correct treatment from evidence, and escalating rather than guessing when the evidence did not settle it.

evidence.label: Visual and layout quality assurance
evidence.evidence: Caught spacing, alignment, imagery, alt-text and broken-link faults across email and web builds — visual QA alongside the editorial pass, not instead of it.

evidence.label: Concise defect feedback to designers and developers
evidence.evidence: Delivered concise, actionable QA feedback to designers and developers in a fast-paced agency production cycle, which is what kept rework down.

watchOuts: The title says “social media specialist” — this is a writing job, whatever reviewing the description also mentions.
You would meet this employer’s requirements more than the day-to-day work justifies — the score is held to what the work itself is worth.
